rules: Every change must identify scope, affected systems, paths, risk, validation plan and rollback plan.
The implementer cannot be the independent auditor for the same change.
Independent AI audit is advisory evidence and never substitutes for human approval.
A designated Human Owner must approve before implementation begins.
High-risk, destructive, security-sensitive, permission-changing, migration and production-impacting changes require explicit Platform Owner approval.
Production merge and deployment are separate actions requiring their own explicit authorization.
No workflow may write directly to main as part of routine implementation.
Approval records must identify actor, role, decision, timestamp, target change and reviewed commit.
